goal: The fw-plan directory-delivery checklist (template source and its committed rendered copy, kept in lockstep) instructs planners to derive each task's file surface from context.relevant plus grader run paths and to declare a shared conflict_keys entry or overlap_ok marker for any concurrent overlap, naming flywheel validate as the enforcement gate.

graders.run: uv run python -c 'from flywheel_orchestrator._skills import render_skill, SkillRenderSettings; import pathlib, sys; sys.exit(0 if render_skill("fw-plan", SkillRenderSettings()) == pathlib.Path(".claude/skills/fw-plan/SKILL.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8") else 1)'
graders.name: render-lockstep

assertions: The directory-delivery checklist instructs the planner to derive each task's file surface from context.relevant entries (with ' -- ' annotation suffixes stripped) plus command-grader run paths.

The checklist states that two tasks with overlapping surfaces and no prerequisite chain must either share a conflict_keys entry or list the reviewed-safe path in overlap_ok, and names flywheel validate as the gate that enforces this after files are written.
graders.name: checklist-substance

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skill_templates/fw-plan-delivery-directory.md -- the template SOURCE flywheel init renders: add the conflict-surface checklist to STEP 4 (draft task JSON) and a 'run flywheel validate' step to STEP 6 (after writing files).

.claude/skills/fw-plan/SKILL.md -- the committed rendered copy (managed-by flywheel init), currently byte-equal to render_skill('fw-plan', SkillRenderSettings()); it must receive the SAME edit by regeneration, not hand-editing, so both files land in this one change.

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skills.py -- render_skill/SkillRenderSettings and the __FW_DELIVERY__/__FW_TASKS_DIR__ binding; use this renderer to regenerate the committed copy.
docs/orchestration.md -- the shipped description of conflict_keys and overlap_ok the checklist wording must agree with (updated by the prerequisite task).
constraints: Edit the template source, then regenerate .claude/skills/fw-plan/SKILL.md through the real renderer; the render-lockstep grader fails any divergence between the two, and both files must be committed in this same change.

The checklist must state: derive each task's file surface as context.relevant paths (strip ' -- ' annotations) plus command-grader run paths; any two tasks whose surfaces overlap and that are not chained via prerequisites must share a conflict_keys entry or list the reviewed-safe path in the top-level overlap_ok array; flywheel validate enforces this, and STEP 6 must run it after writing task files.

Present conflict_keys and overlap_ok as top-level task-JSON keys of the directory work source (the delivery block's concern), not as core Task or context fields -- the main template's schema table and its 'do not invent fields' rule stay untouched and remain true.
Keep all __FW_*__ placeholders intact; concise checklist prose, no emojis.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not change lint or validate behavior (the prerequisite task owns all code); this task touches markdown templates and the rendered skill only.
Do not edit fw-plan.md's core schema table and do not edit fw-plan-delivery-github.md (GitHub sources do not carry conflict_keys).
Do not hand-edit the rendered SKILL.md out of lockstep with the template source.
Do not modify or weaken test_skills.py.
edge_cases: Adding the guidance tokens to only one of the two files passes the greps for that file but fails render-lockstep -- the pair of graders is deliberate.
The delivery template renders into other repos via flywheel init, so the wording must not assume this repo's paths beyond the __FW_TASKS_DIR__ placeholder.
